name: Hikari Food Service Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hikari Food Service Co., Ltd. operates food and beverage businesses in Japan. It runs standing bars named Tachinomi Yakiton Daikoku, Fish camellia and Kanayama family, plus a directly operated meat wholesaler outlet called Yakiniku Marui Butcher Shop. The company dates from 2009 and has its base in Nagoya, Japan.
